items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I replaced Don with Fletcher, and then replaced him again with McKinney.

ctx.x: You see? Yeah, so I replaced Don with Fletcher, and then replaced him again with McKinney.

Uh huh. In your own arranging, did you work closely in any way, or did you go to Don Redman for advice -- how did your arranging at that time ... you arranged for Fletcher Henderson -- he did, I guess.
